title: All-Purpose Chicken Mince

items: 2 packets of oregano and chilli flakes each, i use dominoes ;)
300 grams chicken mince, pre cooked with 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tsp freshly ground pepper

method: Start by heating your 1/2 tsp oil in a saucepan and cook your mince. set aside
Add the other 1/2 tsp of oil and heat, followed by yourr onion and garlic

Saute till your onion is translucent then add in your mushrooms and cook till ready, follow that up with your tomatoes and allow it to cook till super soft. while the tomatoes are cooking, add in your oregano - chilli flakes
Add in your cooked mince to the mushroom - tomato mix and bring it together.
> you can cook the chicken mix with the vegetables if you prefer and removing the additional first step.
After the tomatoes are soft, add in the chicken mince along with 1/4 cup of tomato puree and a few tbsp of water if needed
Let this cook for a few minutes till your mince is ready
> you can add in carrots finely chopped, bell peppers too to this mix
> fresh basil into the mix a few minutes before it is ready goes a long way with flavour
caption:
this chicken mince is a god sent in everyway. 
it works with every type of dish you would want. serve it as a ragu with pasta, as a taco filling, makes the perfect lasagna filling as well, you can even spoon it into lettuce cups for a low cal dinner

Ingredients: 
- 1 tsp olive oil
- 5 cloves of garlic
- 1/2 onion, finely chopped
- 1 packet of buttom mushrooms, sliced
- 1 tomato, finely chopped
- 2 packets of oregano and chilli flakes each, i use dominoes ;)
- 300 grams chicken mince, pre cooked with 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tsp freshly ground pepper

Method: 
- start by heating your 1/2 tsp oil in a saucepan and cook your mince. set aside 
- add the other 1/2 tsp of oil and heat, followed by yourr onion and garlic
- saute till your onion is translucent then add in your mushrooms and cook till ready, follow that up with your tomatoes and allow it to cook till super soft. while the tomatoes are cooking, add in your oregano - chilli flakes
- add in your cooked mince to the mushroom - tomato mix and bring it together. 

Ella's Tips:
-> you can cook the chicken mix with the vegetables if you prefer and removing the additional first step. 
after the tomatoes are soft, add in the chicken mince along with 1/4 cup of tomato puree and a few tbsp of water if needed
let this cook for a few minutes till your mince is ready

-> you can add in carrots finely chopped, bell peppers too to this mix

-> fresh basil into the mix a few minutes before it is ready goes a long way with flavour
